title: ReplaceBy() on CurrentEditedScene causes crash [4.3+]
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.3-stable
- Tested in all rendering solutions

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable.mono - Windows 10.0.19045 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7260) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700K (28 Threads)

### Issue description

This may be expected behavior as I am attempting to replace the root node as part of a modifier/importer. If so, then it would be helpful to know how to change the node type for the root node of the currently edited scene.

## Expected behavior
I am running an addon script that should replace the root node from Node3D to a custom node (though for the purposes of this bug I was able to isolate the issue to the tree position, not the node type). Creating a new node from code, and calling replaceby on the root should allow me to swap the nodes:

Original Tree:
Root
- Child
- Child
- - ChildChild

```csharp
public void TestReplacement()
{
    _root = EditorInterface.Singleton.GetEditedSceneRoot();
    var replacement = new Node() { Name = "Replacement" };
    _root.ReplaceBy(replacement);
    _root.QueueFree();
}
```
Expected New Tree:
Replacement
- Child
- Child
- - ChildChild

## Actual behavior
When calling ReplaceBy() on the root node of the currently edited scene, the Editor crashes.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the reproduction project
2. Enable the ReplaceByTests addon in the project settings
3. In the new TestsPanel, click "Load Scene" to load the test scene
4. Observe the node tree
5. Press "Run Test" without the "Root Test" button checked. Observe the children nodes are correctly replaced
6. Press "Run Test" with the "Root Test" button checked. The editor will crash and print no messages.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I have not yet confirmed this is a C# only issue. Will make an MRP shortly in GDScript and if it also fails I will upload.
[replacebytest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19874760/replacebytest.zip)

### Related Issues
Neither of these are direct answers to the issue as far as I can tell but they are related issues. In particular the root node changing issue could possibly be the same mechanism, I'm just not sure how to test that it is the same cause.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/86314
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/72555
